title: Family F05: the merge and the whole left-end round proved in Lean; no halt in 10<sup>1000</sup> steps
text: For the five-state core shared by 40 holdouts, Lean now proves the merge of a used-up block and the round from one left-end event to the next, for every block list, given only that the nested visits end as clean ones do. A new accelerator built from these rules runs 1RB0LC_0RC0RB_1LD0RE_0LE0LF_1LA0LB_0RA--- to 10<sup>1000</sup> steps and 37 machines of the family to 10<sup>300</sup>. Exact halt scans show that a halt needs a block to run out while its drift to the next block is within a few tens of 0; the smallest drift seen is 1,048.
